//: pm2 process definition for the Brand Brain FastAPI service.
deploy.sh only ever runs 'pm2 restart brand-brain', and falls back to
'pm2 start' with this file if the process is not registered yet.
Paths are absolute because pm2 resolves 'interpreter' against its own cwd,
not the app's. If you deploy somewhere other than /opt/brand-brain, change
cwd/script/interpreter here and set the APP_DIR repo variable to match.
'interpreter' points at the virtualenv python — without it pm2 assumes node
and the process dies instantly with a syntax error.
